literal.prompt: Как сегодня называется город, где произошла Сталинградская битва?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page places the Volgograd memorial under the Stalingrad Battle and WWII collections and states the city was Stalingrad through 1961. Official regional/city pages establish that the three other labels are distinct Russian cities and support their notes. Only Volgograd is the current name associated with the Stalingrad Battle.
literalGroups.locator: PRlib L37-L51; alternative notes: Ekaterinburg L95-L99, Samara L25-L29, Rostov PDF P1 L0-L1.

literalGroups.literal: Сталинград с 1961 года называется Волгоградом. Памятная плита в Волгограде посвящена защитникам города, погибшим в дни Сталинградской битвы 1942–1943 годов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library page states that the memorial plaque names soldiers and officers of the 62nd and 64th armies as defenders of the city who died during the Stalingrad Battle of 1942–1943. The revised sentence paraphrases this specific detail, without making a broader claim about the battle’s strategic significance.
literalGroups.locator: Presidential Library, turn1view0 L51; complete returned body retained at /originalRecord/payload/output/1/text.

The Presidential Library page identifies Volgograd and states that the city was Stalingrad from 1925 to 1961, supporting the year in this note.
